SECTION 7 — SIMPLE TALK

BIG PICTURE
This part say: if bad thing happen and outside person sue, who pay? Also say: how much pay, max?

7.1 — PROTECT EACH OTHER (INDEMNIFICATION)
Both sides same rule. If your side mess up — break promise, act super careless or bad on purpose, or your stuff steal someone else patent/copyright — you must protect other side. Pay their lawyer, pay their loss, defend them in court.
BUT: not fair if bad thing happen because other side changed your stuff, mixed your stuff with different stuff, or used your stuff wrong way outside deal. Then you not owe protect.

Key words:
- Indemnify = you cover their loss, like shield for them.
- Indemnifying Party = side who broke thing, must shield.
- Indemnified Party = side who get hurt, gets shield.
- Claim = outside person complain/sue.
- Losses = money pain from claim — damages, fines, lawyer cost.

7.2 — HOW PROTECT WORKS (PROCEDURE)
Hurt side must tell breaker side fast, in writing, about claim. Forget tell fast? Still get shield, unless late-tell hurt breaker side bad.
Breaker side take over fight in court, make choices.
Breaker side can settle claim, but if settle say hurt-side guilty or make hurt-side do weird non-money thing — need hurt-side say okay first (and hurt-side no can say no just to be mean).
Hurt side must help when asked, breaker side pay for that help.

7.3 — MONEY CEILING (LIMITATION OF LIABILITY)
Most time: no one pay for weird indirect loss — like lost future profit, lost reputation, lost data, extra punishment money. Even if warn ahead, still no pay this kind.

Exception — these NOT capped, can pay big:
- Broke promise to shield other side (7.1 stuff)
- Leak secret info (confidentiality)
- Super careless or bad-on-purpose act
- Steal other side patent/copyright

For everything else: total pay ceiling = bigger of two number —
(A) money customer pay in last 12 month, or
(B) $100,000.
Whichever bigger, that the max. Cannot go over, except the exception list above.

SHORT VERSION FOR REGULAR PERSON
Break deal or steal idea or act reckless? You cover other guy cost, they help you fight it, you control defense. Can't dump blame-settle on them without ok. Normal mistake beyond that? Pay capped small — biggest of year fee or hundred-thousand dollar. Big-bad stuff (secret leak, steal IP, reckless act, broken shield-promise) — no cap, pay full.
